summary_1line: Rama calmly accepts Kaikeyi’s demand for exile, prioritizing obedience to his father and dharma while preparing to leave Ayodhya without distress.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Dasharatha collapses weeping on a golden couch while Rama stands calm before Kaikeyi who demands his exile.
Rama reverently circumambulates the royal coronation items prepared for him and silently dedicates them to Bharata.
Lakshmana, eyes red with tears and anger, follows Rama as he leaves the royal chamber after bowing to his father and Kaikeyi.
